title: Technical Program Manager
job_description:
Technical Program Manager

Join our delivery organization to coordinate complex software initiatives from planning through launch. You will help product and engineering teams make dependencies visible, resolve risks early, and keep executives and customers aligned.

Basic Qualifications
- 3+ years of program or project-management experience in a technology environment.
- Experience maintaining cross-functional roadmaps, milestones, dependencies, and risk registers.
- Strong stakeholder communication and executive status reporting.
- Experience using Jira or a comparable project-management system.
- Experience administering Salesforce for program reporting.

Preferred Qualifications
- Scrum Master certification.
- Experience facilitating retrospectives and process improvement.
- Experience using SQL to investigate program metrics.
